title: SRS Protocol Definition (ext:protocol)
description: An epistemically ordered process for building quality Records through structured conversation or facilitation. A Protocol is a package definition — declared in package-manifest.json's `protocols` array and stored under the package's `protocols/` subtree — not an instance Record. RFC-038 [R8] classifies a declared definition against the schema for its declared kind; this file is that schema, owed by RFC-038's Schema-changes table and landed by the #297 cutover. Property names carry the `protocol` prefix, which is the shape the corpus, the CLI and the reference implementation all use.

$schema.description: Optional schema declaration. When present it must name this schema — a Protocol is classified by the package manifest's `protocols` array, so the declaration is confirmation, not the classifier.

protocolId.description: Stable UUID identity for this Protocol definition. Globally stable across copy and import.

protocolNamespace.description: The namespace this Protocol belongs to. Canonical form is namespace/name@version.

protocolName.description: snake_case or kebab-case name, unique within the namespace.

protocolVersion.description: Monotonically increasing version within this UUID lineage. Starts at 1. Changing namespace or name requires a new UUID.

protocolDescription.description: What this Protocol is for and when to run it.

protocolTargetType.description: The Record type this Protocol converges on — a LINEAGE reference (bare Type UUID; rfc-decision-c8704763). The canonical namespace/name@version form is DISPLAY-only and is never stored here. Loose exploratory Protocols whose output is input context for a tighter Protocol may carry an empty string.

protocolStages.description: The stages, in declaration order. Execution sequence is determined by dependsOn resolution, not by array position; `order` is the declared composition order of the stages — structure, not presentation; it provides the render default (Invariant 31).

ProtocolStage.description: A named stage in a Protocol. Stages carry epistemic dependencies (dependsOn), not merely ordering: a stage may proceed only when its dependencies are sufficient.

stageId.description: Stable key within this Protocol. Referenced by other stages' dependsOn (Invariant 29).

order.description: The declared composition order of the stages — structure, not presentation; provides the render default. Execution order is determined by dependsOn. Must be consistent with the partial order implied by dependsOn (Invariant 31).

question.description: The core question this stage answers.

dependsOn.description: stageId values within the enclosing Protocol. Epistemic dependencies, not just ordering. A stage may not depend on itself (Invariant 29).

completionCriteria.description: How to know this stage is sufficient to proceed.

contributesTo.description: The Record Fields this stage feeds (Invariant 30).

outputType.description: Present when this stage produces its own intermediate Record. A LINEAGE reference (bare Type UUID; rfc-decision-c8704763) — the effective package set resolves it. Previously the version-optional TypeRef object; typeVersion is dropped (version-optional hybrids are forbidden).

aiGuidance.description: Extraction guidance for an AI assistant working this stage. A plain string, or the structured AiGuidance object used elsewhere in the model.

FieldRef.description: A reference to a Field, optionally scoped to the Type it appears in.

typeId.description: Which Type this Field appears in, when the same fieldId appears in several.
